theorem lg_target (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y) : f 0 = 0 := by
  have : f 0 = f 0 + f 0 :=
    by rw [hf 0 0]
  rw [this]
  convert (add_right_cancel (f 0) (f 0) (f 0)) using 1
  rw [add_right_comm (f 0) (f 0) (f 0)]
  rw [add_right_cancel (f 0) (f 0) (f 0)]
  exact add_right_cancel (f 0) (f 0) (f 0)
